_doc: hero_v6 mini sheet frame plan. Same contract as test128/assets/anim/hero8.json: 256x256 canvas, fixed feet root (128,189), figure height 124, scale 1:1. Left-side directions are mirrors of the right side.

idle.action: breathing idle, standing still holding the sword lowered in the right hand

walk.action: walking at a steady pace, sword held low in the right hand

run.action: Fast running cycle, looping: upper body leaning forward, long strides with the knees lifting high, arms swinging opposite the legs, the sword held low in the right hand trailing behind the body pointing down and back, the sword is never raised
